schema.title: Response 200 Login Api V1 Auth Login Post

post.description:
With `mfa_token`: complete a sign-in. Without it, with a bearer token: confirm a new
TOTP factor from /auth/mfa/enroll (returns new tokens and the recovery codes, once).

schema.title: Response 200 Mfa Verify Api V1 Auth Mfa Verify Post

post.description:
Redeems a pairing code. The credential is in this response only; a replay of the same
request returns `device_credential: null` (DECISIONS D23).
Exchanges the device credential for a 1-hour device token (security spec, Credentials).
Returns a locked or disabled device to active.
Returns a signed URL; PUT the file there with the given headers within its lifetime.
